description: Net salary after income tax and social contributions for an employee in one of ten countries (uk, us, ca, au, in, br, pl, fr, de, es), computed live by the LifeByNumbers salary calculators (same operator). Takes a gross salary in local currency (annual by default, or monthly with period) and a country code, plus optional state and filingStatus for the US, province for Canada, region (england|scotland) for the UK. Returns gross, net and total deductions (each annual and monthly), a line-by-line breakdown typed as tax / social / contribution / repayment, effectiveRate, the tax year the figures apply to, currency, the assumptions behind the estimate and the upstream calculator page as source. Spain (es) is listed but answers covered:false because lifebynumbers.net computes it client-side only.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lower case: uk, us, ca, au, in, br, pl, fr, de, es

gross.description: gross salary in local currency, annual unless period is monthly, e.g. 50000

period.description: period of gross (default annual); results always give both annual and monthly

province.description: Canada only: two-letter province/territory code, e.g. BC (default ON)

region.description: UK only: scotland applies Scottish income tax bands (default england)

state.description: US only: two-letter state code, e.g. TX (default CA)

name: take_home_pay
title: Take-home pay
